topic: AI Tool That Writes Code in Seconds—Is It Replacing Developers?
hook: "AI is about to replace millions of software developers—faster than you think."
script:
[0:00-0:03] HOOK  
"AI is about to replace millions of software developers—faster than you think."

[0:03-0:08] CONTEXT  
"Recently, AI tools like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT started writing complex code in mere seconds. Developers worldwide are stunned by how quickly these tools generate working software."

[0:08-0:18] EVIDENCE  
"GitHub Copilot, trained on billions of lines of code, can autocomplete entire functions instantly. Companies report up to 40% productivity boosts, while beginners write apps without deep programming knowledge."

[0:18-0:28] TENSION  
"But here’s the catch: AI lacks true understanding. It can produce buggy or insecure code, and complex projects still need human oversight. Yet many fear this tech could make junior developers obsolete."

[0:28-0:35] PAYOFF  
"The truth? AI won’t replace developers—it’ll redefine their role. Programmers will shift from writing lines of code to supervising AI, focusing on creativity, logic, and problem-solving."

[0:35-0:42] CTA  
"Want to stay ahead in tech? Follow for more AI insights. Do you think AI will help or hurt developers? Comment below!"
